_note: Sample decks for the deck viewer on Our Work. To add one: save the redacted PDF in source/decks/ (git-ignored, never public/), add an entry here, run `node scripts/build-deck.mjs <id>`, commit the images in public/<folder>/, then set "deck": "<id>" on the matching case study in case-studies.json. Only entries with "live": true are shown. Never name or describe the client in any field here (confidentiality rule).

decks.title: Climate Adaptation & Resilience
decks.subtitle: Investment opportunities
decks.summary: A 61-slide read-deck on the global and U.S. climate adaptation and resilience (A&R) investment landscape and where private capital can enter. It sizes the market, separates A&R from broader sustainability spending, and finds that A&R remains underfunded, with private participation still limited and the most scalable opportunities concentrated in developed economies, chiefly the U.S.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Climate exposure across infrastructure, labor and trade assets; the five A&R verticals; the A&R financing gap; U.S. geographic fragmentation; and recent entry by large private equity funds.

sections.title: Disaster lifecycle
sections.text: Pre-, during- and post-disaster spending. Pre-disaster adaptation is underinvested yet carries strong benefit-cost ratios, while most capital is deployed after losses occur.

sections.title: Regulation
sections.text: Federal and state resilience funding, building-code fragmentation, regulatory mandates and cost-sharing, and the role of insurance in pricing and transferring risk.

sections.title: Stakeholders
sections.text: How government, households and businesses spend on A&R, public-private partnership entry routes, and a synthesis ranking climate risk analytics, retrofitting and agricultural A&R as the most attractive areas.

sections.title: Climate risk analytics
sections.text: The climate data value chain, the dominance of public data infrastructure, consolidation of pure-play risk analytics into integrated platforms, and regulatory moats.

sections.title: Agriculture
sections.text: Agricultural A&R mapped by commercial maturity and private equity fit across seasonal volatility, controlled environment agriculture, seed innovation, soil and land, water, and labor.

sections.title: Retrofitting products & services
sections.text: Retrofit products and services, a Florida building-code case study and a comparable state thesis, fragmentation across six retrofit service stages, and two platform strategies.

sections.title: Conclusion & investment strategy
sections.text: A&R is an emerging market with limited late-stage platform maturity, which favors a growth equity posture ahead of a larger future buyout opportunity.
